Card Q&A.a: The [When Digivolving] effect activates first. As soon as your Digimon attacks, the "when your Digimon attacks, you may digivolve that Digimon" effects trigger simultaneously. You activate the 1st effect, digivolve a Digimon, then its [When Digivolving] effect triggers, and you therefore activate it first due to the derived trigger rule.
Card Q&A.q: When multiple "when your Digimon attacks, you may digivolve that Digimon" effects trigger, I activated the 1st effect, then the digivolved Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect triggered. At such times, in what order can I activate the other "when your Digimon attacks, you may digivolve that Digimon" effects and that [When Digivolving] effect?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Tyrannomon] in its name or the [Dinosaur] trait in the hand.
